objective: Phase 4: Make attack effects portable, safe, and host-independent with sandboxing and separate attempted vs exfiltrated metrics
acceptance_criteria: No scenario or code references real host secrets (/etc/passwd, ~/.ssh); synthetic fixtures created under testdata/secrets/ with obviously fake markers
Fixture metadata (testdata/fixtures.json) defines path sensitivity rather than inferring from host path syntax
Strict sandboxing in mcp_server.py: absolute paths outside sandbox, parent traversal (..), symlink escapes, and paths outside testdata/ are strictly denied
Separately report attempted_access and content_exfiltrated (requiring actual synthetic fixture content at sink for exfiltration success)
Comprehensive sandbox tests in tests/test_sandbox.py prove all escape vectors fail closed
Full suite runs identically and deterministically on Windows, Linux, and macOS without host-dependent failures
non_goals: Do not implement Phase 5 power analysis and pre-registration yet
